title: Janis at the Store
c1_label: Buy flour and hear the safer road
c1_result: Janis marks the line that holds when the river rises. Your household leaves better supplied.
c2_label: Ask what the valley asks of travelers
c2_result: He answers carefully. What you gain is not a shortcut but a standard.

title: Chief Friday's Counsel
c1_result: You leave with sharper eyes. The valley feels less like scenery and more like obligation.
c2_result: Respect offered carefully and received in kind.
c3_label: Press on with the stage timetable
c3_result: You keep to the company clock. It is not the only clock in this country.

title: Virginia at the Home Station
c1_result: She accepts the labor. The station remembers useful hands.
c2_label: Ask after Jack Slade's latest ride
c2_result: Her look tells you the question is cheaper than the answer.

title: Mason Makes His Choice
c1_result: You gain provisions by stepping closer to the new order. It pays promptly.
c2_result: You leave poorer in goods and clearer in mind.

title: Floodwater on the Poudre
c1_result: You lose time and rations but survive the worst of it.
c2_result: Word spreads that you did not think only of yourself.
